item.title: **Recipe Name:** Irresistible Peach Cobbler Cookies
item.description: **Recipe Name:** Irresistible Peach Cobbler Cookies **Ingredients:** - Unsalted butter (1 cup, softened) - Granulated sugar (1½ cups) - Brown sugar (½ cup) - Eggs (2 large) - Vanilla extract (1 tsp) - All-purpose flour (2¾ cups) - Baking soda (1 tsp) - Salt (½ tsp) - Fresh peaches (2 cups, peeled and diced) - Cinnamon sugar (2 tbsp) **Instructions:** Preheat oven to 350°F. Cream butter and sugars until fluffy. Beat in eggs and vanilla. Mix flour, baking soda, and salt, then combine with wet ingredients. Fold in peaches. Drop spoonfuls onto a baking sheet, sprinkle with cinnamon sugar. Bake for 12-15 minutes. Cool and enjoy!

item.title: Peach Pie Bits
item.description: Mid June in Northern Virginia means 🍑 Peach Pie Bites 2 ripe peaches, peeled and diced 1 tablespoon brown sugar ¼ teaspoon cinnamon 1 teaspoon lemon juice 1 sheet refrigerated pie crust (or use homemade!) 1 egg (for egg wash) Optional: coarse sugar for sprinkling Preheat oven to 375°F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper. In a bowl, mix diced peaches with brown sugar, cinnamon, and lemon juice. Roll out pie crust and cut into small circles using a cookie cutter or the rim of a cup. Spoon a small amount of the peach mixture into the center of each circle. Fold into a half-moon and gently press edges with a fork to seal. Brush with egg wash and sprinkle with a little coarse sugar if desired. Bake for 12–15 minutes, or until golden brown. Let cool slightly and enjoy!

item.description: **Serves 1** - 2 peaches, sliced - 2 tomatoes (can use a mix with cherry tomatoes too), cut into chunks - 100g halloumi, cubed - 1 shallot, thinly sliced (optional) - 2 tbsp rice **Dressing** - 2 tbsp fish sauce - 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil - 1 tsp honey - 1 Thai red chilli, finely chopped - 1 clove garlic, grated - 1 lime, juiced - Large handful of mint Toast the rice in a pan until golden. Remove and grind to a powder. In the same pan, add 1 tbsp olive oil and fry the halloumi. You can also air-fry for 10 minutes. Combine all the ingredients for the dressing. Plate up the tomatoes, halloumi, peaches (and shallots if using), pour over the dressing, and top with mint and toasted rice.
